field_gain.note: Without the field-gain division the RAW energy is lower by exactly ln(0.908) = -0.097; the corrected effect is evaluated through the quadratic correction (comparison: *_without_gain_division), since the correction depends on ln E_raw nonlinearly.

shadow.note: Differences come from the 0.4 km march step and the bilinear sampling of the 3 km ridge on a 0.4 km grid. The clamped case flags all its rays as meeting missing terrain.
